text:
maria: uploaded a quick Figma of the batch table with row-level actions + export flow. can we hammer out semantics? https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
ada: looking now. big question: should the export button export the current filter or the selected rows? i think default = filtered, with a small dropdown: [Export ▾] -> [Export filtered / Export selected]
sam: backend note: exporting filtered is easiest (stream query -> CSV). exporting "selected" requires passing explicit ids; fine but we should surface a warning if selection > 10k rows. we have a 50k streaming cap rn.
leo: product perspective: defaulting to filtered matches user expectation for table exports. but for reranking workflows people often select a handful of rows to re-run — so we need both.
jess: accessibility nit: the dropdown needs keyboard focus and an ARIA label like `aria-label="Export options"`. also ensure the export modal doesn't trap focus when closed. screen reader should announce export size warning.
ada: small copy tweak: instead of "Export filtered" use "Export all results" and "Export selection". less ambiguous. also add a helper tooltip: "Exports the rows currently shown by your filters".
maria: SGTM. another question: should vector previews be included in CSV or only in JSON export? vectors can be long and break CSV UX.
sam: suggest two formats: CSV (no vectors) and JSONL (includes vector array or base64). add a checkbox in the export modal: [ ] Include vectors (JSONL only). if user checks it and picks CSV, show toast: "Vectors are only available in JSONL format."

leo: agree — default CSV for ease of use, JSONL for debugging/reproducibility. also include metadata columns: `original_query`, `rerank_delta`, `model_version`.
ada: UX layout idea: export modal has left column for format & rows (Filtered / Selected / Range), right column for options (Include vectors, Include metadata, Compression: none/gzip). keep primary CTA = "Start export".
jess: accessibility: modal title should be `h2` and keyboard shortcut `E` to open export when table focused (announce via tooltip). ensure Checkboxes have `role=checkbox` + `aria-checked` states. table row checkboxes need `aria-labelledby` to the doc title cell.
sam: implementation detail: streaming JSONL gzipped is supported by the API. add `Content-Encoding: gzip` header in responses when Compression = gzip. also add an estimated size calc for the UI once user toggles Include vectors (very rough, e.g., "~45 MB").
maria: about the inline vector preview: current mock shows a small 8-dim sparkline on hover. should that be a column or a hover-only tooltip? hover-only saves horizontal space but is discoverability meh.
ada: make it hover + keyboard focus to reveal (so it works for keyboard users). label it "Vector preview" and show first 10 dims with copy-to-clipboard button.
leo: product ask: export schema must be stable across releases. add `export_schema_version` header/field in JSONL so downstream jobs can detect changes.
jess: export file accessibility: when export completes, the download toast should include a textual summary (e.g., "Export ready: 2,342 rows — 3 files — View details") and a button "Copy download link" with `aria-label`.
ada: UI nit on table: relevance column header should include both `score` and `rank` toggles. propose header: "Relevance · score ↑" with small tooltip describing scale (0-1).
maria: quick CSV header example for JSONL mapping (for docs):
```
id,query_text,doc_text,relevance_score,rerank_delta,model_version
```
That would be used for CSV; JSONL lines include a `vector` key with array.
sam: question for infra — if user requests export of > 50k rows to JSONL w/ vectors we should queue and email link when ready. else for <50k we stream. can we get a product decision?
leo: yes, queue > 50k. show message: "Large export — we'll email you a download link when it's ready." opt-in for push notifications.
maria: last design point: row actions (rerank, view vectors, pin) are in a right-side ellipsis menu. should "View vectors" open the same Vector preview modal as hover? consistency good.
ada: consistency is good. also add keyboard shortcut `V` to open vector preview for focused row (announce dims verbally for screen readers).
design-bot: Figma updated: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (version 3) — changed modal layout + added JSONL option. @maria
jess: quick accessibility checklist attached in thread: keyboard nav, aria labels, announce file size, focus return after modal close. i'll add to the ticket.
sam: I'll start on the API spec PR: `/exports/create` params: `format: csv|jsonl`, `scope: filtered|selected|range`, `include_vectors: bool`, `compress: gzip|none`. will tag infra for queueing logic.
maria: thanks all — i'll push a small copy update and iterate mock. will ping @design for a quick review after updates. :thumbsup:
